question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guidance path: 6.7 -> 7.7 -> 8.5 -> 9.2B (steps of 0.7-1.0B). Q4 guidance historically jumps more than Q3's (+0.5B in FY2025, +0.8B in FY2026). The CFO guided FY2027 opex growth to the 'low 50s' percent; against restated FY2026 non-GAAP opex of ~22.7B (estimated) that implies Q4 non-GAAP of ~9.7-10.4B, so GAAP ~9.9-10.6B. Actuals tend to come in slightly under guidance. Median 10.1B. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold.

- Status quo: guidance keeps stepping up each quarter; the full-year growth target implies a Q4 level that depends on the Q3 actual.
- Resolution: resolves off the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release (the Q4 FY27 GAAP opex figure, or the midpoint if a range is given), rounded to $0.1B.
- Event window: the Q3 FY27 release, expected around Nov 18-19, 2026; as of Oct 17, 2026 not yet published.
